title: Democrats take control of Texas SBOE, promise to move beyond culture wars
summary: Incoming Democrats on the Texas State Board of Education say they want to move beyond years of contentious curriculum fights, while Republicans argue politics will remain part of the board's work.

title: No. 3 Texas clinches SEC Championship Game berth with 16-6 win over Texas A&M
summary: No. 3 Texas leaned on its defense and three Gianni Spetic field goals to defeat rival Texas A&M 16-6, setting up a rematch with No. 1 Georgia in the SEC Championship Game.
